apps.name: Update Distro
apps.description: One-click system update for your Linux environment. Recommended to keep your environment secure and up to date.

install_scripts.apk:
set -e
echo '==> Updating Alpine packages (apk)...'
apk update
apk upgrade
echo '==> Alpine system updated successfully!'
install_scripts.apt:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export DEBCONF_NONINTERACTIVE_SEEN=true
echo '==> Updating APT repositories and packages...'
echo "==> Checking merged /usr links (base-files)…"
for d in bin lib sbin lib32 lib64 libo32 libx32; do
  link="/$d"
  if [ -L "$link" ]; then
    target=$(readlink "$link" || true)
    case "$target" in
      /*) dest="$target" ;;
      *) dest="/$target" ;;
    esac
    if [ ! -d "$dest" ]; then
      case "$d" in
        lib32|lib64|libo32|libx32)
          echo "Removing dangling /$d -> $target"
          rm -f "$link"
          ;;
        *)
          if [ -d "/usr/$d" ]; then
            echo "Pointing /$d at usr/$d (was dangling $target)"
            ln -sfn "usr/$d" "$link"
          else
            echo "! /$d -> $target is dangling and /usr/$d is missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          ;;
      esac
    elif [ "$target" != "usr/$d" ] && [ -d "/usr/$d" ]; then
      case "$d:$target" in
        lib64:usr/lib/*-linux-gnu*) ;;
        *)
          echo "Pointing /$d at usr/$d (was $target)"
          ln -sfn "usr/$d" "$link"
          ;;
      esac
    fi
  elif [ -d "$link" ]; then
    case "$d" in
      lib32|lib64|libo32|libx32) ;;
      *)
        if [ -d "/usr/$d" ] && [ -x /usr/bin/ln ] && [ -x /usr/bin/mv ]; then
          echo "Merging directory /$d into /usr/$d"
          for item in "$link"/*; do
            [ -e "$item" ] || continue
            base=$(basename "$item")
            if [ ! -e "/usr/$d/$base" ]; then
              cp -a "$item" "/usr/$d/$base"
            fi
          done
          /usr/bin/mv "$link" "/$d.pre-usrmerge"
          /usr/bin/ln -s "usr/$d" "$link"
        else
          echo "! /$d is a directory, but base-files requires a symlink to usr/$d"
          exit 1
        fi
        ;;
    esac
  fi
done
apt-get update
apt-get -f install -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold
apt-get upgrade -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold
apt-get clean
echo '==> APT repositories and packages updated successfully!'

install_scripts.default:
set -e
echo '==> Detecting package manager...'
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  export DEBCONF_NONINTERACTIVE_SEEN=true
  echo "==> Checking merged /usr links (base-files)…"
  for d in bin lib sbin lib32 lib64 libo32 libx32; do
    link="/$d"
    if [ -L "$link" ]; then
      target=$(readlink "$link" || true)
      case "$target" in
        /*) dest="$target" ;;
        *) dest="/$target" ;;
      esac
      if [ ! -d "$dest" ]; then
        case "$d" in
          lib32|lib64|libo32|libx32)
            echo "Removing dangling /$d -> $target"
            rm -f "$link"
            ;;
          *)
            if [ -d "/usr/$d" ]; then
              echo "Pointing /$d at usr/$d (was dangling $target)"
              ln -sfn "usr/$d" "$link"
            else
              echo "! /$d -> $target is dangling and /usr/$d is missing"
              exit 1
            fi
            ;;
        esac
      elif [ "$target" != "usr/$d" ] && [ -d "/usr/$d" ]; then
        case "$d:$target" in
          lib64:usr/lib/*-linux-gnu*) ;;
          *)
            echo "Pointing /$d at usr/$d (was $target)"
            ln -sfn "usr/$d" "$link"
            ;;
        esac
      fi
    elif [ -d "$link" ]; then
      case "$d" in
        lib32|lib64|libo32|libx32) ;;
        *)
          if [ -d "/usr/$d" ] && [ -x /usr/bin/ln ] && [ -x /usr/bin/mv ]; then
            echo "Merging directory /$d into /usr/$d"
            for item in "$link"/*; do
              [ -e "$item" ] || continue
              base=$(basename "$item")
              if [ ! -e "/usr/$d/$base" ]; then
                cp -a "$item" "/usr/$d/$base"
              fi
            done
            /usr/bin/mv "$link" "/$d.pre-usrmerge"
            /usr/bin/ln -s "usr/$d" "$link"
          else
            echo "! /$d is a directory, but base-files requires a symlink to usr/$d"
            exit 1
          fi
          ;;
      esac
    fi
  done
  apt-get update
  apt-get -f install -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold
  apt-get upgrade -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold
  apt-get clean
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk update
  apk upgrade
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Syu --noconfirm
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf upgrade -y
elif command -v xbps-install >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  xbps-install -Syu -y
elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  zypper --non-interactive refresh
  zypper --non-interactive update -y
else
  echo 'No recognized package manager found.'
  exit 1
fi
echo '==> System packages updated successfully!'

apps.name: Chromium
apps.description: Open-source Chromium browser. After install, open it from the desktop menu.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.description: Firefox (ESR on Debian/Ubuntu/Kali). Find it in the desktop menu after install.

apps.name: Thunderbird
apps.description: Mozilla Thunderbird mail and calendar. Works in the desktop session after install.

apps.name: VS Code
apps.description: Visual Studio Code. Distro package is code-oss or code when available; Debian-family images download Microsoft’s .deb. Can also be installed directly from pre-packaged GitHub releases.

apps.name: Geany
apps.description: Small GTK IDE and editor. Reliable in PRoot and lighter than VS Code on phones.

apps.name: Neovim
apps.description: Neovim (nvim). Use it from Terminal or a desktop terminal emulator.

apps.name: Python
apps.description: Python 3 interpreter. pip is included when the distro ships python3-pip / py3-pip.

apps.name: Git
apps.description: Git command-line tools for cloning and committing inside the environment.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.description: GNU Image Manipulation Program. Open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.description: SVG editor. Works in the desktop session. Large download.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VLC media player. Hardware video decode is limited in PRoot; software decode still plays most files.

apps.name: MPV
apps.description: mpv, a lightweight player. Good default when VLC feels heavy.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.description: Writer, Calc, Impress. This is a large install and can take several minutes on a phone.

apps.name: Blender
apps.description: Model, sculpt, animate, and render in Blender. Open it from the desktop menu after install. This is a large download.

apps.name: Krita
apps.description: Krita for illustration and painting. Open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: Darktable
apps.description: Non-destructive raw photo editor. Open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.description: Record and edit audio. Open Audacity from the desktop menu after install.

apps.name: Kdenlive
apps.description: Multi-track video editor. Open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: FFmpeg
apps.description: Convert and inspect media from the terminal with ffmpeg and ffprobe.

apps.name: FileZilla
apps.description: Transfer files with FTP, FTPS, and SFTP. Open FileZilla from the desktop menu.

apps.name: Telegram
apps.description: Telegram Desktop. Sign in after install and open it from the desktop menu. Large download.

apps.name: Remmina
apps.description: Connect to other computers with RDP, VNC, and SSH. Open Remmina from the desktop menu.

apps.name: Node.js
apps.description: Node.js and npm for the terminal. On some distros npm is included with nodejs.

apps.name: Go
apps.description: Go compiler and tools. Use go from the terminal after install.

apps.name: OpenJDK
apps.description: Java runtime and javac. Use java and javac from the terminal. Large download.

apps.name: Build Tools
apps.description: Compilers and Make for building C and C++ projects inside the environment. Large download.

apps.name: htop
apps.description: Interactive process viewer. Run htop in the terminal.

apps.name: tmux
apps.description: Keep terminal sessions open in panes and windows. Run tmux in the terminal.
